snippet.title: SVETIK - A Dark RPG Where Your Light Can Betray You | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
SVETIK is a dark 2D narrative RPG where your only source of light is a sentient being.

It remembers your choices.
It changes.
And it may turn against you.

Explore a world consumed by darkness, fight twisted creatures, and decide whether the light will trust you… or abandon you.

Wishlist on Steam — search “SVETIK”.

#indiegame #gamedev #rpg #darkfantasy
